policy.description: Declared runtime budgets remain the review baseline. Runs up to and including 20 percent above warn or strict thresholds are recorded as tolerated host fluctuation; `build/scripts/test/run.sh --strict` blocks only above the strict fluctuation ceiling.
policy.baseline_rule: Each baseline cites its successful matrix artifact or an explicit local evidence source; new owner suites use their first successful bounded run while historical broad baselines remain available for comparison.
policy.review_rule: Raise a budget only with a recorded reason; prefer narrowing or moving weak default gates before accepting slower defaults.

budgets.cost_center: Focused Vitest package run with happy-dom component tests
budgets.decision: keep focused owner-domain frontend suite
budgets.notes: User-authorized runtime recalibration on 2026-09-29, not an acceleration claim. The complete focused owner passed in 40571ms on dev-02; another successful bounded run measured 42738ms in matrix-run-2026-09-28T13-11-52-759Z.json. After productive Mermaid corrections and review, all 307 tests in 65 files passed functionally in 40994ms (matrix-run-2026-09-29T02-21-21-629Z.json); its strict exit 125 was exclusively the obsolete 25000ms budget. The historical June baseline was 8787ms; the July dev-01 cleanup passed 260 tests in 13062ms. Retain the complete package owner because shared Database and Timeline consumers need coverage; no split, test deletion or scope reduction is part of this recalibration. Keep the eight-worker cap, 600-second timeout, assertions and global 20-percent tolerance unchanged. Transform/import/environment setup is a material cost center. These host-local measurements do not establish the cause of the cross-host difference.

The forced composite build passed on dev-02 in 16948ms; another successful bounded run measured 16784ms in matrix-run-2026-09-28T13-11-52-759Z.json. The current build completed functionally in 19057ms (matrix-run-2026-09-29T00-36-33-183Z.json); its strict exit 125 was exclusively the obsolete 10000ms budget. Preserve the historical dev-01 measurements of 6175/6025/6145ms (median 6145ms) from matrix-run-2026-08-28T21-23-56-734Z.json. Keep --force and referenced-project checking: narrowing to noEmit or an incremental stale-output check would weaken the gate. The command, graph, 180-second timeout and global 20-percent tolerance are unchanged. These host-local measurements do not establish the cause of the cross-host difference.

budgets.cost_center: Focused @virgultum/block-mermaid package-scoped Vitest run
budgets.decision: use this package-scoped Vitest gate for Mermaid changed paths instead of the root Virgultum name-filter command
budgets.notes: P-TCI-C-04 measured three pre-containment runs at 10373/10292/10539 ms after deleting six duplicate stale source-boundary tests; median 10373 ms. After the shared diagnostic contract began defaulting unspecified matrix commands to two workers, comparable 506-test runs measured 55057/54058/55562 ms (median 55057 ms). While the correction was in flight, f8034a9ee1 normalized the shared contract to eight workers; clean latest-wip 506-test baselines then measured 22909/22652/21409 ms (median 22652 ms). A mixed Node/happy-dom experiment measured 25051/25647/24615 ms (median 25051 ms, 10.6% slower than clean latest-wip) and was rejected. The final correction therefore retains one happy-dom environment, pins the current eight-worker contract explicitly, and consolidates 14 boundary tests into two invariant gates (494 tests total). Three strict dev-02 runs passed at 21631/21482/21230 ms (median 21482 ms, 61.0% below the two-worker median and 5.2% below the clean eight-worker latest-wip median) in output/test-runs/matrix-run-2026-07-15T15-02-37-765Z.json, matrix-run-2026-07-15T15-02-59-341Z.json and matrix-run-2026-07-15T15-03-20-660Z.json. The historical baseline and all budgets and timeouts remain unchanged; the current result must not be described as an all-time acceleration.

budgets.cost_center: Seventy-nine exact API smoke filters in the dedicated integration_quick target, executed serially in one process
budgets.decision: keep exact smoke subset, bound its cold compile surface and leave the 1,000+ test target to api.integration
budgets.notes: Historical baseline: the 2026-07-27 replacement target completed its then-current smoke set, compile/link and isolated service lifecycle in 53.796 seconds. The 120-second strict budget was last set on 2026-06-27; the 2026-08-28 description still covered forty-one filters. On 2026-09-13 the user authorized a 180-second strict budget for the current seventy-nine unchanged filters after removing repeated Cargo/test-process launches. Current complete measurements: 142.359 seconds profiled warm, 152.698 seconds first warm and 165.079 seconds including the target rebuild. The historical attempt artifacts, including failures under the previous budget, were removed at the user’s request on 2026-10-05. The warning budget, historical baseline, test scope and global 20-percent fluctuation tolerance remain unchanged; the strict tolerance ceiling is now 216 seconds. This calibration is not a runtime optimization or a fully cold-build guarantee. Since the capability partition, this is historical evidence for the former 79-case aggregate, not a measurement of the eight-case shared API group. Existing thresholds are unchanged.
